note: Phase 3 closes on an exception list, the same shape Phase 2 closed on, and it is a partial close: 61 of its 376 function rows are closed. Its 114 data objects stand at `classified`, the terminal rung a data object's structural proof gives it, so they are accounted for by that state and appear in neither list. Every Phase 3 function row in inventory.json appears exactly once below and validate_inventory.py enforces that, recomputes the counts from these entries, checks every gate against the real target registry and rejects a closure claiming a falsification it does not carry. What the 61 amount to: the 27 named exports and the four continuation rows the census splits them into, closed by the staged-pair differentials; the contact emitter, the primitive half of matrix B, and eight of the nine non-mesh matrix A entries with the vtable slot-5 partners they dispatch into, closed by NxPhysicsCollisionTests, which loads the pinned DLL in its own process, re-hashes it and calls the recorded RVAs directly. What they do not amount to is the phase: the mesh column, the compound entries, the rest of matrix B's primitive half, the broad phase and the continuous-collision subtree are all still open, and 282 rows below say only that Phase 3 ran out of dispatches -- 62 of which the census has since raised to `reconstructed` through later work that recorded a proof and aimed no mutation at them; their reason predates that and is carried as written. Three limits are in the numbers themselves. First, the sixteen first-dispatch export rows record the measurement completely and the edit not at all, and the two have to be separated because they are not the same weakness. The measurement is traceable: evidence/phase3-leaf-kernels.md carries a per-row `mutation delta` column for all sixteen, those sixteen deltas sum to the 67 differing cases its own totals block states, the positive control in the same run read 142, and every one of the sixteen is a leaf whose Ghidra `called` list is empty -- so no delta there can have been produced by a callee, which is the misattribution that later reassigned `phys_fn_001010`'s 242 to NxRayCapsuleIntersect. The edit is not reproducible: the evidence records the sixteen mutations collectively -- one per row, each perturbing that kernel alone -- and never names the line any one of them changed, so the mutation field paraphrases the collective statement and re-running a single row means deriving its edit again. That is a reproducibility gap, and it is the smaller of the two this ledger has to declare. The sharper one is `phys_fn_001741`/`phys_fn_001743`, now the only place here where a delta is published without the site that produced it: evidence/phase3-narrow-phase.md tables all eight of that row's mutations, but only the closing one -- the corner depth test written as a float compare -- is recorded against a site, and the three further non-zero counts (557,830, 120 + 57,942 and 3,053) are carried by every committed record as bare numbers. The row closes on the one that names its site; the other three are published as counts, because choosing a site for them now would be a reconstruction rather than a reading. Second, `phys_fn_001901` is deferred rather than closed although Phase 3's own record calls it closed, because every mutation recorded for its dispatch changes the emitter it calls; its deferral entry says so. Third, two rows here are closed on algorithmic agreement under a control word they do not execute under, with the divergence pinned -- `phys_fn_001775` at 43 words and `phys_fn_001010` at 242, and the 242 has since been shown to belong to its callee NxRayCapsuleIntersect, a Phase 2-era Task 2 export. gates/phase3.json carries that as an escalation. Where the guarantee ends is where Phase 2 left it and one step further. Recomputed counts and a required non-zero delta make the strongest claim the costly one; they do not make a false one impossible, because the probe transcripts are not committed artifacts. And Phase 3 itself demonstrated the deeper limit: evidence in this programme is relative to the reachability graph known at the time, and recovering the dispatch matrix moved five rows Task 2 had already closed into a different floating-point environment. That is why nothing here is `closed` in the inventory: these rows are `dynamically_gated`, which says a gate entered them and caught a mutation, and the terminal rung stays Phase 8's to grant. P4 Task 1c removed seven rows from this ledger because the census no longer gives them to Phase 3: five IcePrunable.cpp rows and phys_fn_004842/004844, which the source correspondence map identifies as OPCODE Ice/IceContainer.cpp members. All seven were deferred not_reconstructed_in_phase, so no closure left with them and the 61 is unchanged. After the close the canonical line gave 42 of this phase's rows to Phase 5 as a side effect of transcribing them, with no ownership evidence behind the moves and provenance the oracle contradicted, and none of them closed here. Those moves are replaced by shape_slot_ruling.json, the shape-class vtable ruling validate_inventory.py recomputes: a slot the collision pipeline dispatches through is Phase 3's and every other slot of the shape classes is Phase 5's. Under it 29 function rows left this ledger for Phase 5 -- the shape classes' object-model slots, their constructors and destructors, and the helpers only those call -- three left for shared runtime (phys_fn_001945, 001947 and 001955, whose callers now disagree) and one for Phase 4 (phys_fn_004859); 17 came in -- thirteen rows the ruling places with collision (BOX slots 5, 7 and 9 and the box hull facade's seven collision slots, which the generator had given Phase 5 through the box constructor's installer edge, and SPHERE slot 9, the base sweep stub and the slot-9 Prunable adapter, which the canonical line had moved), phys_fn_001075 and phys_fn_001329, whose Phase 5 translation_unit claims no __FILE__ span supported, and phys_fn_001730 with its continuation, whose callers now agree on this phase. The eleven reconstructed arrivals are deferred reconstructed_not_falsified: no Phase 3 gate ever aimed a mutation at them. phys_fn_001753 is deferred not_reconstructed_in_phase rather than blocked, because its slot-5 partner is now this phase's own row. None of the 61 closed rows moved, which is why the function count is 376 and the closed count is still 61. And the port of the Phase 4 close re-deferred phys_fn_002344, which the Phase 5 remover-chain round had closed here on Phase 5's NxPhysicsObjectLayoutTests: that gate does not run when this phase is gated, so the closure rested on nothing this phase's gate executes. Its deferral, which carries the mutation, both readings and the dirty control, went to Phase 5 with the row when the shape slot ruling made it a helper of ShapeBase's destructor; the 61 closed rows are the same 61 described above. The review of the ruling moved six more function rows, none of them closed: phys_fn_000967, phys_fn_000969 and phys_fn_000971, BOX_HULL slots 6, 7 and 8, arrive from Phase 5 deferred reconstructed_not_falsified, because phys_fn_000959, BOX_HULL slot 10, dispatches all three on its own this; and phys_fn_000887, phys_fn_000889 and phys_fn_000903 leave for Phase 7, where the census regeneration check places them by their callers. The function count stays 376 and the closed count 61. The three data objects the box-hull rows read arrive with them and phys_data_005007 leaves for Phase 5, so the phase owns 114 data objects.

proof_kinds.differential_falsified: a mutation was aimed at this row's reconstruction in a throwaway `git archive` copy, rebuilt, and run against the committed oracle transcript through a Phase 3 staged-pair target. NxPhysicsGeometryTests prints one line per case and NxPhysicsKernelFuzzTests one digest per export, so what a per-row probe reports is a count of differing cases or differing digests rather than the whole-target `stdout_delta` run_differential.ps1 prints; the detection records the unit it was measured in rather than converting it, and the gate is the target that produced it. Every one of these runs was accompanied by an un-mutated copy of the same tree built and run in the same session reading zero
proof_kinds.static_proof_falsified: a mutation was aimed at this row and the static-proof gate failed the named check; there is no oracle side, so this is weaker than any differential. Phase 3 closes no row this way
proof_kinds.oracle_differential_falsified: a mutation was aimed at this row's reconstruction in a throwaway `git archive` copy, rebuilt, and run through NxPhysicsCollisionTests -- a target that loads the pinned DLL in its own process, checks its hash and calls the recorded internal address directly, because none of these rows is exported and the public path that would reach them is Phase 4, 5 and 7 work that does not exist. It runs once rather than once per pair, so there is no transcript to diff and the detection is a mismatch count against the shipped bytes. Where one mutation was measured on more than one block or under both control words the largest single count is recorded and the mutation names the split

deferred_reasons.blocked_on_later_phase: the row, or something it must dispatch into to be driven at all, belongs to a phase after 3. Eighteen rows: the thirteen that make up the dispatch matrix's mesh column and its continuations, matrix B's [BOX][CAPSULE] entry and the four rows of the continuous-collision subtree. Matrix A's [BOX][CAPSULE] entry, phys_fn_001753, was one until the shape slot ruling put its slot-5 partner phys_fn_000949 in this phase, and phys_fn_002344 until the ruling gave it to Phase 5 as a helper of ShapeBase's destructor
deferred_reasons.not_independently_falsifiable: the row has no counterpart in the candidate that can be mutated on its own. Unused here
deferred_reasons.homeless_shared_code: Phase 2's reason for shared code with no translation unit span. Unused here
deferred_reasons.not_reconstructed_in_phase: Phase 3 did not reconstruct this row and names nothing that blocks it. This is a debt, not an obstruction, and it is the largest single category in this ledger. No per-row reachability claim is made for these 282 rows, and that is deliberate: this component dispatches through function-pointer tables and vtable slots and the census splits functions at their internal alignment padding, so a call-edge closure over them systematically undercounts -- four separate counting methods in this programme have each answered a narrower question than the one asked, the last of them a call-edge walk that could not see a continuation row. Some of these rows will turn out to be blocked on Phase 4 mesh data once someone walks them properly; asserting which ones without walking them is the claim this reason refuses to make. Where the evidence does say something specific about a row -- the six compound entries, matrix B's [CAPSULE][CAPSULE] -- the entry carries a note
deferred_reasons.reconstructed_not_falsified: the row is reconstructed and driven against the pinned oracle, and no mutation aimed at its own body is recorded. Fifteen rows: `phys_fn_001901`, and fourteen the shape slot ruling and its review brought in after the close, reconstructed on the Phase 5 line and never aimed at by a Phase 3 mutation. This is not `unreachable` and not `blocked`: the instrument exists and runs, and what is missing is one mutation
deferred_reasons.data_object_not_dispositioned: a Phase 3 data object that no Phase 3 task dispositioned. A data object has no body to mutate and no transcript of its own, so it cannot carry a code proof kind; Phase 2 left its 1,055 in the same state and this list makes the same debt countable rather than silent. One of the 112 is load-bearing and named in the evidence: phys_data_000006 at 0x0003acc0, the 24-byte switch table phys_fn_001745's `jmp dword ptr [ecx*4+0x1003acc0]` walks, whose six slots were all resolved when that row was closed

entry_points: the 27 named Phase 3 exports, resolved by GetProcAddress against both staged pairs
measured_from.method: the exports are driven through a staged-pair differential; every other address above is called directly inside NxPhysicsCollisionTests against the pinned DLL after a hash check, because no public API path reaches them. Each closed row was entered by a block that prints an oracle-side digest, and every digest and coverage line is registered in tools/gate_targets.ps1 with a per-phase floor, so a generator that degrades to nothing fails the gate rather than passing it
measured_from.rows_reachable_within_phase_3: not stated. Both walks available -- direct call edges over the census, and the closure used by Phase 2 -- are known to undercount this component: it dispatches through two function-pointer matrices and per-type vtable slots, and a continuation row is not a call target. A number produced by either would be an answer to a narrower question, and this ledger declines to publish one rather than publish a floor that reads like a total
measured_from.control_words: every NxPhysicsCollisionTests block is driven under both 0x027f, the CRT default, and 0x0f7f, the _PC_64 | _RC_CHOP word Scene::simulate installs. Which word a row actually executes under, and which one it agrees under, is recorded per row in the evidence and escalated in gates/phase3.json
